definition: ἀκάθαρτος, -ον  (ἀ- neg., καθαίρω), [in LXX chiefly for טָמֵא ;] unclean, impure; __(a) physically (LS, MM, VGT, see word); __(b) ceremonially: Act.10:14,28 11:8, 1Co.7:14, 2Co.6:17, Rev.18:2;  __(with) morally: Eph.5:5, Rev.17:4; with πνεῦμα, as always in Gosp., Mat.10:1 12:43, Mrk.1:23,26,27 3:11,30 5:2,8,13 6:7 7:25 9:25, Luk.4:33,36 6:18 8:29 9:42 11:24, Act.5:16 8:7, Rev.16:13 (cf. Cremer, 320).  † (AS)
